verdict.rationale: 1Password's own docs say it can store and quickly access one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website, and its Apple Watch docs confirm one-time passwords can be viewed there. However, the pack never mentions scanning a QR code to set up an account or how quickly codes start generating. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of QR-code scanning for TOTP setup, a description of the setup flow from scan to generated code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account
